reading: This sketch is a full Kanban board: a top toolbar with nav links and a search field, four column headers (To do/In progress/Review/Done) with counts, two dashed section dividers labeled "WEB APP" and "MOBILE", and a set of individual task cards (bugs, features, chores) with tags, titles, progress bars and avatar dots, some struck-through as done.
